papers.title: The D^0 -> K^0 \bar{K^0} decay beyond factorization
papers.authors: J. 0. Eeg, S. Fajfer, J. Zupan
papers.abstract: The decay mode D^0 -> K^0 \bar{K^0} has no factorizable contribution. We calculate the nonfactorizable chiral loop contributions of order O(p^3)and then we use a heavy-light type chiral quark model to calculate nonfactorizable tree level terms, also of order O(p^3), proportional to the gluon condensate. Calculated chiral loops and the gluon condensate contributions are of the same order of magnitude as the experimental amplitude.

papers.title: LIGOs Quantum Response to Squeezed States
papers.authors: L. McCuller, S. E. Dwyer, A. C. Green
papers.abstract: Gravitational Wave interferometers achieve their profound sensitivity by combining a Michelson interferometer with optical cavities, suspended masses, and now, squeezed quantum states of light. These states modify the measurement process of the LIGO, VIRGO and GEO600 interferometers to reduce the quantum noise that masks astrophysical signals; thus, improvements to squeezing are essential to further expand our gravitational view of the universe. papers.title: Multi-messenger Observations of a Binary Neutron Star Merger
papers.authors: LIGO Scientific Collaboration, Virgo Collaboration, Fermi GBM
papers.abstract: On 2017 August 17 a binary neutron star coalescence candidate (later designated GW170817) with merger time 12:41:04 UTC was observed through gravitational waves by the Advanced LIGO and Advanced Virgo detectors. The Fermi Gamma-ray Burst Monitor independently detected a gamma-ray burst (GRB 170817A) with a time delay of $\sim$1.7 s with respect to the merger time. papers.title: Combined dark matter search towards dwarf spheroidal galaxies with Fermi-LAT, HAWC, H.E.S.S., MAGIC, and VERITAS
papers.abstract: Dwarf spheroidal galaxies (dSphs) are excellent targets for indirect dark matter (DM) searches using gamma-ray telescopes because they are thought to have high DM content and a low astrophysical background. The sensitivity of these searches is improved by combining the observations of dSphs made by different gamma-ray telescopes. papers.title: An analysis of binary microlensing event OGLE-2015-BLG-0060
papers.authors: Y. Tsapras, A. Cassan, C. Ranc
papers.abstract: We present the analysis of stellar binary microlensing event OGLE-2015-BLG-0060 based on observations obtained from 13 different telescopes. Intensive coverage of the anomalous parts of the light curve was achieved by automated follow-up observations from the robotic telescopes of the Las Cumbres Observatory. briefs.title: The D^0 -> K^0 \bar{K^0} decay beyond factorization
briefs.brief: This paper presents theoretical calculations of a D⁰ meson decay process using chiral perturbation theory and heavy-light quark models. It addresses particle physics at the weak-decay level and has no connection to computational anomalies or experimental constraint systems; the research target appears to reference results from a computational benchmark, not particle physics.
